label: Kozlowski and Klein (2000)
text: Organizations do not 'perform'; individuals in organizations perform in ways that allow the organizations to achieve desirable performance outcomes.

label: Mary Parker Follet on management
text: Management is 'the art of getting things done through people'.

label: James A.F. Stoner on management
text: Management is the process of planning, organizing, leading and controlling the efforts of organization members and of using all other organizational resources to achieve stated organizational goals.

label: Henri Fayol POCCC
text: The four functions approach (POLC) traces back to Henri Fayol's POCCC: planning, organizing, leading and controlling.

label: Stephen P Robbins on OB
text: Organisational Behaviour is a systematic study of the actions and attitudes that people exhibit within the organisations.

label: Lessons for 'Undercover' Bosses
text: The case study that closes the introduction module.

label: TIME cover: Fare Games
text: A TIME cover dated January 13, 1986 with the headline 'Fare Games: Flying Has Never Been Cheaper' and the caption People Express Chairman Donald Burr.

label: Donald Burr: a background story
text: 1965 joined National Aviation Corporation; 1972 became President; 1973 joined Texas International Airlines; 1979 President; 1980 resigned and set off to found PE.

label: Donald Burr's family-style company
text: A totally horizontal organisation built on a family concept: no power levels, free flow of communication, extensive job rotation, easy access to top management, free redressal of grievances and share options for employees.

label: People Express grows too large too fast
text: 1980 to 1984: rapid growth and high profits; Burr bought up airline companies and just brought them together as one large heterogenous group; employees from different work cultures were forced into the family-styled organisation without any induction program.

label: Ms. Hellinger is fired
text: Burr's most loyal employee, Ms. Hellinger, expressed her true opinion of what was happening to her boss; Burr fired her in retaliation, and employees lost morale and motivation.

label: Great minds who changed their vision
text: Many successful people, including great minds like Buddha and Gandhi, experienced life changing events which restructured their value system and their mission in life.

label: Freddie Laker
text: British airline entrepreneur whose forays into low-cost air travel had attracted much press in the 1970s; Burr was influenced by him.

label: Pilots loading baggage
text: Under complete job rotation and sharing, everybody had to be prepared to take up any other's job, so even the pilots were expected to help with the loading of baggage in case of need.

label: The 1985 acquisitions
text: In 1985 People Express bought out Denver-based Frontier Airlines, becoming the United States' fifth largest airline with a transatlantic route to Brussels; it also purchased Britt Airways and Provincetown-Boston Airlines (PBA).

label: Ms. Hellinger is fired
text: A founder employee who was very critical of Donald Burr's lack of accessibility and disinterest in employee grievances; Burr retaliated by firing her in March 1986.
